# `api.catalog.bulk_upsert`

> `POST /Bulk/upsert` — Catalog

**Python**

```python
api.catalog.bulk_upsert(*, data: BulkUpsertRequest | dict) -> List[CatalogWithLotsDto]
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab catalog bulk_upsert [--data ...]
```

POST /Bulk/upsert.

Args:
    data: Bulk upsert payload — a :class:`BulkUpsertRequest`
        with a single ``catalogs`` list. Each entry is a
        :class:`BulkUpsertCatalogRequest` containing nested
        ``lots`` (:class:`BulkUpsertLotRequest`) and a single
        ``seller`` (:class:`BulkUpsertSellerRequest`). The
        top-level shape is a nested tree, *not* a flat list.
        Accepts a :class:`BulkUpsertRequest` instance or a dict.

        Rows are matched on ``customer_catalog_id`` /
        ``customer_item_id``, so re-sending a payload updates the
        existing records instead of duplicating them.

        Every catalog must name its ``platform_id``. Corporate
        callers (``CorporateAdmin``, ``CorporateAccounting``) have no
        ``partnerIds`` claim for the API to resolve a platform from,
        and requiring it of everyone keeps a payload's meaning
        independent of who sends it. To derive it from your own
        token, read ``partner_ids`` off
        :meth:`~ab.http.HttpClient.bearer_claims` and map it with
        ``api.platforms.list(partner_id=...)``.

Returns:
    list[CatalogWithLotsDto]: The upserted catalogs.

Raises:
    pydantic.ValidationError: When any catalog omits ``platform_id``.
        Reported at ``catalogs.<i>.platformId``, before any HTTP call.

Request model: :class:`BulkUpsertRequest`

## Request body — `BulkUpsertRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalogs` | `list[BulkUpsertCatalogRequest]` | no | Catalogs to upsert, each with nested lots and seller |

## Response

Returns a list of `List[CatalogWithLotsDto]`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `int` | yes | Catalog ID |
| `agentCompanyIds` | `Optional[list[str]]` | no | Agent company IDs assigned to the catalog |
| `title` | `Optional[str]` | no | Catalog title |
| `startDate` | `datetime` | yes | Catalog start date-time |
| `endDate` | `datetime` | yes | Catalog end date-time |
| `isCompleted` | `bool` | yes | Whether the catalog is completed |
| `seller` | `Optional[SellerDto]` | no | Owning seller |
| `platforms` | `Optional[list[CatalogPlatformDto]]` | no | Platform associations carrying the catalog's external IDs |
| `lots` | `Optional[list[LotCatalogInformationDto]]` | no | Lot summaries belonging to the catalog |
